results.content: ❖ The situation at the time of writing in early 2025 indicates that finance challenges will deepen as many donors are cutting their budgets dramatically, including the US governme[...]o a moderate extent 4 = To a large extent 5 = To a very large extent 6 = Don't know 2022-2024 ICVA Impact Study 69 | P a g e Annex IV: Impact Study 2022-2024 Assessment Framework IMPACT STUDY PURPOSE ICVA’s 2030 Strategy has as a goal the promotion of principled and effective humanitarian action through work delivered across three focus areas and five transformation areas, expected to contribute to the following long-term outcomes: • Forced Migration focus area: Improved protection, assistance and durable solutions for refugees, internally displaced persons and migrants in vulnerable solutions; • Coordination focus area: People and communities affected by crisis are better protected and served through strengthened principled and coordinated NGO action; • Financing focus area: Humanitarian financing that meets the needs of populations affected by crisis; • Transformation 1: Championing principled humanitarian action; • Transformation 2: Addressing the impact of climate change on humanitarian action; • Transformation 3: Being globally distributed and locally rooted; • Transformation 4: Being diverse, inclusive and living our values; • Transformation 5: Proactively engaging in agile, collaborative partnerships.
